searched.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PA6-GF
searched.note: All 5 pages read (text layer, page by page): Basic Info, Specifications and Recommended Printing Settings (p.1), Physical and Mechanical Properties (p.2), Other Physical and Chemical Properties and Specimen Test (p.3), test charts (p.4, images), Disclaimer (p.5). No filament length, hardness or diameter tolerance is given. Rows with no registry key: Spool Material "PC + ABS (Temperature resistance 90 °C)", Spool Size "Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm", Printing and Storage Humidity "< 20% RH (Sealed with desiccant)", Retraction Length 0.8 - 1.4 mm, Retraction Speed 20 - 40 mm/s, Max Overhang Angle ~ 70°, Max Bridging Length ~ 40 mm, Melt Index, Crystallization Temperature, Saturated Water Absorption Rate 2.56%, Young's Modulus, the chemical-resistance rows, and the annealing advice (80 to 130 °C, 6 to 12 hours). The Chamber Temperature row (45 - 60 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp, a printer key (see notes). The Nozzle Size row is written to extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters.

searched.title: Bambu PA6-GF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701N08
searched.note: All 19 pages read. Section 2 (p.3): not classified under (EC) No 1272/2008. Section 3 (p.4): Nylon 6 80-90 % by wt, glass fibre 10-20 % by wt. Section 8 (pp.8-9): fibre-debris handling warning, gloves advised. Section 9 (pp.9-10): "No data available" for melting point, density and every other physical datum. Section 14 (pp.13-14): not hazardous goods (IMDG, DOT, ADR/RID, ICAO/IATA). Section 15 (p.16): SVHC not listed. No certification is named.

searched.title: Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PA6-GF
searched.note: One page, 8 colours in a 2-column grid: read for the published hex codes (the "hex" list), not for spec keys. The table names colours without colour codes, so each is matched to the store value of the same colour name. Brown #5B492F, Yellow #FFCE00 and Lime #C5ED48 have no store value (the store page says "PA6-GF Yellow, Lime and Brown have been discontinued.").

searched.title: Filament guide - Printer, Nozzle, AMS, Build Plate, Glue Compatibility and Required Parameters

documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PA6-GF
Bambu PA6-GF Safety Data Sheet SDS20260701N08
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PA6-GF
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility
ABS GF / PA6 GF Glass Fiber Filament Usage Guide

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (Mechanical Properties; specimens printed at nozzle 265 °C, bed 100 °C, 100 mm/s, 100% infill, annealed and dried at 80 °C for 12 h before testing); the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 27 ± 5 MPa, elongation 2.3 ± 0.7 %, bending modulus 2300 ± 120 MPa, bending strength 51 ± 5 MPa, impact 4.1 ± 0.7 kJ/m²) are in the rows' notes only. Density, melting, glass transition, Vicat and HDT come from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (p.1, "Chamber Temperature 45 - 60 °C") is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (registry type number, template field chamber_temp_max), and this is a recommended range for printing the filament; no other filament file stores it.

motion.max_flow is neither curated nor marked not_published: the glass-fibre wiki's speed table (Advanced Adjustments › 1. Improve Surface Quality, "PA6-GF | ＜130 mm/s | 10.5 mm³/s", column "Suggested Maximum Volumetric Flow Rate") is a slicing suggestion, and motion.max_flow is a printer / hotend key, as in the PET-CF, PA6-CF, PPA-CF and PPS-CF files.

material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 6, "Diameter: 1.75mm +/- 0.03mm", verified official_page in the payload); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

material.spool_type is not written: the store page has no spool bullet (its only spool fact is the option value "Filament with spool", which the deterministic layer keeps), and the TDS rows "Spool Material PC + ABS (Temperature resistance 90 °C)" and "Spool Size Diameter: 200 mm; Height: 67 mm" give the spool's material and size, not its type.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/s5/default/b2dc06336623429facff535fbf463b3d.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.

Adjudication against the second extraction. First pass (103 field disagreements with the file as first drafted): added extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters (TDS p.1 Nozzle Size) and recommended_with → Smooth PEI Plate (glass-fibre wiki, Hardware Compatibility), both checked against the cached documents; corrected material.net_weight to 1 kg, the TDS's own figure (the quote check had flagged 1000 g against "1 kg"), and the P1P note, which now follows the reviewed compat-targets.json (no target). Final pass (94 of 268 compared fields still differed; every one settled, no value changed). Same fact, this file's form kept (46 fields): the hex locators (row/column of the 2-column grid, checked against the cached table); the supported nozzle diameters as plain sizes, the TDS's "recommended" mark on 0.6 mm kept in test_condition, as in every other filament file; the relation locators (Cool Plate SuperTack, Liquid Glue, Glue Stick, Smooth PEI Plate, enclosed printer, A1 models, P1P); the 0.2 mm nozzle relation (the store bullet "0.2 mm Nozzle NOT Compatible", a reviewed-unresolvable label, rather than the FAQ wording "Hotend with Stainless Steel Nozzle 0.2 mm"); the nozzle-material relation (one requires → "Hardened Steel or Tungsten Carbide nozzle" row rather than two compatible_with rows; the material-table wiki says hardened steel is "Required", as in the PA6-CF, PAHT-CF and ABS-GF files); the support relation (compatible_with "Support for PA/PET", as in every other filament file, rather than recommended_with). Kept from this file after checking the documents (48 fields): material.type stays the TDS p.3 Composition cell "Nylon 6, glass fiber", as in every other filament file, not "PA6-GF" from the Basic Info sentence; thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the 1.8 MPa row (158 °C), as in every other filament file, with the 0.45 MPa row (182 °C) in its test_condition; the TDS nozzle-size relation and the three TDS build-plate relations, which the second extraction lacked, are stated by the TDS p.1 (Nozzle Size, Build Plate Type). Not added from the second extraction: material.diameter_tolerance (the store page's own verified row, the same value from the same bullet), material.spool_type (the TDS gives the spool's material and size, not a spool type; the second extraction's value paraphrased two rows), thermal.chamber_temp and motion.max_flow (printer / hotend keys; see the notes above).
